Hi Samira —

Sorry we missed you on the call this morning. I know calendars get hectic (especially on a Sunday — hope you're having a calm one!). I wanted to offer a couple quick, low-friction paths so you can evaluate Redwood without blocking on a live meeting: 

- Option A — Concierge async pack: we record a 10–12 minute tailored walkthrough using the org details you submitted, plus a short checklist you can forward internally. We can deliver this by EOD tomorrow.
- Option B — Micro-slot stack: 3 x 15-minute evening slots this week (Mon/Wed/Thu 5:30–5:45pm PT) — pick any, we adapt the demo to the time.
- Option C — Self-serve deep-dive: step-by-step quickstart doc + sample Docker compose you can run in your environment; includes recommended quantization profiles for developer sandboxes.

I attached a short "concierge pack" outline and a one-click micro-slot link below — if you reply with which route you prefer, I’ll roll it forward immediately. If you prefer I can loop in our solutions engineer (Grace) to tailor the recording.

Attachments: concierge-async-pack.pdf (outline), micro-slot-links.txt (one-click calendar options)

If easier, reply with a single word: CONCIERGE / MICRO / SELF and we’ll take it from there.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
